hooks.name: Lint and test after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, run ruff and pytest (Python) and eslint and vitest (web). Each part skips cleanly until Task 2 creates pyproject.toml or web/package.json.

action.command: sh -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); if [ ! -d "$root/.kiro/specs/engramscope" ]; then for d in "$root"/*/; do if [ -d "${d}.kiro/specs/engramscope" ]; then root="${d%/}"; break; fi; done; fi; cd "$root" || exit 1; ran=0; if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then ran=1; uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q || exit 1; fi; if [ -f web/package.json ]; then ran=1; (cd web && npm run lint && npx vitest --run) || exit 1; fi; [ $ran -eq 1 ] && echo "engramscope checks: all passed" || echo "engramscope checks: nothing to check yet (before Task 2), skipping"'
